# Zero Is a Reading

Version 3.5.1 keeps the sensor working on days the water sits at exactly 0 °C.

## The sensor

- **A reading of 0 °C no longer makes the sensor unavailable.** The integration treated a current reading of exactly 0.0 °C like a missing one: a running sensor turned unavailable with only "Failed to fetch data for place …" in the log, and a place added on such a day could not be set up and kept retrying. This hits northern places such as the Gulf of Bothnia or the White Sea when the water is at freezing. The sensor now shows 0.0 °C. A page without a current reading still makes the sensor unavailable, as in 3.5.0. _[#61]_

## Upgrading

Nothing to change after updating. The card is unchanged; only its version number moves.
